purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical institution inpatient accounting/billing system (nyuin = hospitalization, acct = accounting) for the JMA ORCA electronic medical record system
purpose.summary: This program (ORCSODRNACCT) creates inpatient accounting records for the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It handles hospitalization registration, insurance combination processing, meal/food calculation, room charge calculation, and special inpatient fee accounting. It processes patient admission/discharge events and generates accounting entries for various inpatient charges.

notable_features: 46 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (.INC files)
159 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprogram architecture
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (file-based/MCP data access layer)
MCPDATA.INC and MCPAREA copy suggesting MCP (middleware) data access
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (visible as garbled latin-1 characters). This is the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system, a well-known Japanese healthcare IT system. The program handles inpatient accounting creation (nyuin kaikei sakusei). Source is fixed-format COBOL. No COMP-3 usage is notable for a financial calculation program - numeric fields use PIC 9 without COMP-3.
